description: Check whether a media file can be analysed as audio or video before running ask_ai_chat with analysisInput. Returns whether the file is eligible and, when it is not, a plain-English reason. An unavailable file is a normal result here, not an error. This is the only check that accounts for both the account's opt-in and the server-wide switch, so call it before an audio or video run.

analysisInput.description: Which pass to check: 'audio' (tone, pacing, delivery) or 'video' (also on-screen visuals, gestures, slides). Required.

modelId.description: Optional model id to check against. Omit for the workspace default.

name: check_analysis_eligibility
